bar-gauge.$description: BarGauge: several values as bars bent round one middle.

size.$description: The width of the bars' whole circle.

thickness.$description: How thick a bar is, at most; many bars are thinner.

indent.$description: How far out of the bars the values are written.

spacing.$description: The room between a line and its value, and between the entries of the legend.

connector-width.$description: How thick the line from a bar to its value is.

swatch.$description: The size of a bar's color in the legend.

swatch-radius.$description: How round a bar's color in the legend is.

root.$description: The bar gauge as a whole.

track.$description: The track behind a bar: `color` paints it.

labels.$description: The values at the ends of the bars.

connector.$description: The line from a bar to its value: `color` paints it.
